6. Zamawiający rekomenduje zastosowanie elektronicznego podpisu wewnętrznego na pliku typu .pdf. Zamawiający proponuje wypełnić ofertę elektronicznie w formacie .doc (.docx), przekonwertować do formatu .pdf i opatrzyć podpisem elektronicznym.

description: Errichtung einer industriellen Aufbereitungsanlage zur Verarbeitung von Grasschnitt und Laub aus der Landschaftspflege zu pelletierten oder brikettierten Festbrennstoffen (Kapazität ca. 3.100 t/a) am Standort Industriegelände 6, 17139 Malchin, im Rahmen des vom BMEL über die FNR geförderten Verbundprojekts MOOReturn. Der Auftrag umfasst als Generalübernehmerleistung: Planung (einschließlich Genehmigungsplanung), Bauleistungen (Ertüchtigung der Bestandshalle inkl. Hallentore, Medienerschließung, brandschutztechnischer Ertüchtigung, Sozial- und Sanitärräume) sowie die Beschaffung und Montage sämtlicher Anlagenkomponenten der Prozesskette (Dosierung, Waschmaschine, Abtropftrommel, Feinzerkleinerung, Pressentwässerung, thermische Trocknung, Verdichtung). Die Vergabe als integrierte Gesamtleistung dient der Vermeidung von Schnittstellenrisiken und der Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen, vom Generalübernehmer verantworteten Anlagenkonformität. Die Umsetzung des Auftrags ist in aufeinander aufbauenden Leistungsstufen vorgesehen. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, einzelne Leistungsstufen entsprechend dem Projektfortschritt abzurufen. Die Beauftragung weiterer Leistungsstufen erfolgt jeweils vorbehaltlich der Bereitstellung der Fördermittel sowie des Erreichens der definierten Projektmeilensteine. Ein Anspruch auf Beauftragung weiterer Leistungsstufen besteht nicht. Ausführliche Beschreibung des Beschaffungsvorhabens s. Anlage 1 unter folgendem Link: https://www.dbfz.de/fileadmin/Projektseiten/MooReturn/doc/MoorFaserWerk_Malchin_Kurzexpose_v1.pdf

title: Germany – Load-bearing structure design services – Planungsleistungen Tragwerksplanung gemäß HOAI, Teil 4, Abschnitt 1, §51 für die Maßnahme Neubau/Anbau: Kindergarten Renquishausen
description: Die Gemeinde Renquishausen plant den Neubau eines 4-gruppigen Kindergartens in der Ortsmitte, angrenzend an das Gemeindezentrum. Innerhalb des Gemeindezentrums werden ehemalige Schulräume künftig nicht mehr benötigt und stehen zur Erweiterung der Feuerwehr und für die Nutzung durch den neuen Kindergarten zur Verfügung. Die Verbindung der Bestandsstruktur und Erweiterung soll den Nutzern einen modernen Kindergarten und Synergien mit den bestehenden Nutzungen bieten. Nach einem erfolgten VgV-Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb und Lösungsvorschlag wurden die Objektplanung Gebäude und die Außenanlagen bereits vergeben. Ziel der Gemeinde Renquishausen ein, den aktuellen pädagogischen Maßstäben entsprechender, 4-gruppiger Kindergarten als Holz-Hybridbau. Das Grundstück befindet sich in stadträumlich anspruchsvoller Hanglage. Der zweigeschossige Neubau nutzt die Höhenentwicklung für ebenerdige Zugänge in beiden Geschossen. Der Neubau bindet über einen eingeschossen Zwischenbau mit Dachterrasse an die bestehende Gemeindehalle an.

title: Finland – ENT or audiologist services – Kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja huoltopalvelut ÖVPH Pohjoinen alue
description: Hankinnan kohteena on kuulokojeiden sovitus- ja ylläpitopalvelu Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueen pohjoisella osa-alueella. Palveluun sisältyy lääkinnällisenä kuntoutuksena myönnettyjen kuulokojeiden sovitus ja ylläpitopalvelu sekä muiden yksittäisten korvakappaleisiin ja kuulokojeisiin liittyvien huoltotoimenpiteiden hankinta kaudelle 1.1.2027 - 31.12.2028. Hankintaan sisältyy kaksi kertaa yhden (1 + 1) vuoden optiomahdollisuus (1.1.2029-31.12.2029 ja 1.1.2030-31.12.2030). Option käyttämisestä tehdään erikseen päätös noin kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen sopimuskauden päättymistä. Toiminta-alue on Pohjoinen alue, johon kuuluu Pietarsaari, Kruunupyy, Luoto, Pedersöre ja Uusikaarlepyy. Pietarsaaren alueella on noin 250 kuulonhuoltoasiakasta per vuosi. Asiakasmäärä on arvio eikä tilaaja sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin. Palvelun asiakkaalla on oltava palvelua varten korva-, nenä- ja kurkkutautien toimintayksikön toimintaperiaatteiden mukaisesti hyväksytty lähete tai apuvälinepäätös, jonka määräysten mukaan kuulokojepalvelu toteutetaan. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden tarkastella palvelun järjestämistapaa sopimuskauden aikana. Tarkastelun seurauksena palvelun laajuus voi muuttua tai palvelu voidaan osittain tai kokonaan siirtää tilaajan omaksi toiminnaksi hankintasopimuksen ehtojen mukaisesti.

title: Finland – CT scanners – Liikuteltava kuvantamisyksikkö (mobiili-TT) HUS Diagnostiikkakeskukseen
description: Hankinnan kohteena on yhden (1) uuden tietokonetomografialaitteiston sisältävän liikuteltavan kuvantamisyksikön eli mobiili-TT:n hankinta HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen käyttöön. Perävaunuun sijoitettava tietokonetomografialaitteisto on ns. perustason TT-laitteisto. Laitteiston tulee soveltua monipuolisesti päivystystutkimuksiin, joista tavanomaisimpia ovat pään ja vartalon alueen sekä nivel- ja raajatutkimukset mukaan lukien traumakuvaukset. Lisäksi laitteistolla tehtäviä tutkimuksia ovat verisuoniangiografiat, aivoperfuusiot sekä perustason sepelvaltimokuvaukset ja muut EKG-tahdistetut kuvaukset. Laitteiston tutkimusmäärä voi vaihdella, mutta tavanomaisen tutkimusmäärän arvioidaan olevan n. 5000–7000 tutkimusta vuodessa. Hankittavan laitteiston tulee soveltua yllä kuvattuun käyttötarkoitukseen. Hankinnalle asetettu kattohinta on 1,1 M€ (alv 0%), sisältäen ehdottomat vaatimukset mukaisen peruskokoonpanon ja kokonaisuudessaan liikuteltavan kuvantamisyksikön kokonaisuuden. Kattohinta ei pidä sisällään pakollisia optioita tai huoltosopimuksen kustannuksia. Mikäli tarjotun laitteiston hinta ylittää edellä mainitun kattohinnan, tarjous hylätään. Optiona varataan oikeus enintään kolmen (3) lisälaitteiston hankintaan HUS-yhtymän toiminta-alueelle tai laajemmin valtakunnalliseen käyttöön (HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen koordinoimana) vuosien 2027-2030 aikana. Tarjouksessa ilmoitetut hinnat ovat kiinteät 31.12.2027 asti, jos tarjouspyynnössä tai sen liitteissä ei ole toisin mainittu. Toimittajalla ei ole oikeutta muuttaa hintoja tänä aikana. Hintoja voidaan korottaa vain todellista kustannusten muutosta vastaavasti, optiolaitteiden (2028-2030) osalta sopimusluonnokseen allekirjoitushetkellä kirjatun indeksin mukaisesti. Optiohankinnat eivät ole sitovia. HUS tekee päätöksen mahdollisesta optiohankinnasta ilman ostovelvoitetta tarpeensa mukaisesti. Hankintayksikkö voi keskeyttää hankinnan, mikäli hankkeen rahoitus ei toteudu suunnitellulla tavalla. HUS harkitsee, missä laajuudessa se tekee laitteistojen huoltosopimukset vai hoidetaanko huolto sairaalan omana toimintana. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Vaihtoehtoiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja. Rinnakkaiset tarjoukset eivät ole sallittuja.

title: Finland – Lift-maintenance services – Oulun Tilapalvelut - Hissien huolto- ja korjauspalvelut
description: HANKINNAN KOHDE Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitos pyytää tarjoustanne hallinnoimiensa kiinteistöjen hissien huolto- ja korjauspalveluista sekä hälytyskeskuspalveluista. Hankinnan kohteena ovat hissien kokonaisvaltainen huolto-, kunnossapito-, korjaus- ja päivystyspalvelu. Palveluun sisältyvät lisäksi hissien toiminnan ylläpitämiseksi tarvittavat muut huolto- ja korjaustoimenpiteet. Palvelun tavoitteena on varmistaa hissien turvallinen, luotettava ja keskeytyksetön toiminta sekä ylläpitää laitteiden tekninen kunto valmistajien ohjeiden, viranomaismääräysten ja hyvän kunnossapitotavan mukaisesti. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö on kuvattu tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 1 (Palvelunkuvaus). Lisäksi liitteessä 2, (Laiteluettelo / Tarjousliite) on kerrottu jokaisen hissin vaadittu huoltomäärä vuodessa. SOPIMUSJÄRJESTELY Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely yhden (1) palveluntuottajan kanssa. TOIMEKSIANTOJEN TOTEUTUS Perushuollot toteutetaan sovitun huolto-ohjelman mukaisesti. Kiireettömien töiden tilaukset tehdään P2P-tilausjärjestelmällä, joka toimii samalla tilauksen sopimuksena. Tilauksen yhteydessä sovitaan toimeksiannon sisältö, aikataulu sekä arvioitu työmäärä. Mikäli sovitusta aikataulusta myöhästytään palveluntuottajasta johtuvasta syystä, tilaajalla on oikeus periä sopimusluonnoksen mukaiset sanktiot. HINNOITTELU JA TARJOUKSEN SISÄLTÖ Tarjous tulee laatia tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Tarjouksen tulee kattaa kaikki palvelun toteuttamiseksi tarvittavat työt. Mahdolliset lisätyöt hinnoitellaan tarjouspyynnön mukaisesti. Perushuollot laskutetaan laitekohtaisilla tarjoushinnoilla. Muut huolto- ja korjaustyöt laskutetaan tarjotun tuntihinnan sekä toteutuneen materiaalikulutuksen mukaisesti. SOPIMUSKAUSI Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Sopimuskauden tavoiteltu alkamispäivä on 1.12.2026. Mikäli sopimuskauden aloitus viivästyy esimerkiksi muutoksenhaun vuoksi, sopimuskausi alkaa vasta, kun asiaan on saatu lainvoimainen ratkaisu. Määräaikaisen sopimuskauden jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa optioilla: - yksi (1) + yksi (1) vuotta Optiokaudet alkavat tavoitellusti: - 1.11.2028 (1. optiovuosi) - 1.11.2029 (2. optiovuosi) Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä. Sopimus jatkuu optiokausille automaattisesti, ellei tilaaja ilmoita kirjallisesti halustaan olla käyttämättä optiota viimeistään kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen kunkin optiokauden alkamista. HISSIEN LISÄÄMINEN JA POISTAMINEN Sopimuskaudella hankinnan kohteet voivat lisääntyä tai vähentyä ja tilaajalla on oikeus lisätä tai poistaa kohteita sopimuksesta ilman irtisanomisaikaa. Lisättyihin ja poistettuihin kohteisiin sovelletaan tarjouksen mukaisia hintatasoja. TAKUUAIKAISTEN HISSIEN HUOLTOVASTUU Tämä hankinta ei koske takuuaikaisia huolto- ja korjauspalveluja. Takuuaikaiset hissit pysyvät toimituksesta tai hissin korjauksesta vastanneen toimittajan huollossa takuuajan päättymiseen saakka. Takuuajan päätyttyä huolto- ja korjausvastuu siirtyy tämän sopimuksen mukaiselle palveluntuottajalle. Tilaaja ilmoittaa palveluntuottajalle takuuajan päättymisajankohdan. SOPIMUSEHDOT JA HANKINTAPÄÄTÖS Palvelussa noudatetaan JYSE 2025 -ehtoja. Tilaajalla on oikeus hylätä kaikki tarjoukset perustellusta syystä. Tarjoukset eivät saa sisältää tarjoajan omia ehtoja. HANKINNAN KÄYTTÄJÄT Sopimusta voivat käyttää Oulun Tilapalvelut -liikelaitoksen lisäksi myös muut Oulun kaupungin hallintokunnat ja liikelaitokset, joilla on sama Y-tunnus, kuten Oulun Kaupunkiympäristöpalvelut ja Oulun Vesi.

title: Finland – Energy meters – Kaukolämpömittarit
description: Vantaan Energialla on kaukolämpöverkossaan n. 5 100 kpl lämpöenergiamittaria, näistä etäluenta on toteutettu noin 2 000 laitteen osalta 2G/3G- modeemeilla. Vantaan Energia vaihtaa tulevan 2G-alasajon seurauksena nämä 2 000 laitetta vuoden 2029 loppuun mennessä. Kilpailutukseen sisältyvistä lämpöenergiamittareista suurin osa on kokoluokkaa DN20-DN40 ja jakautuvat pääosin DN20 - DN100 kokoluokkaan. Yksittäisiä kohteita löytyy aina DN150 kokoon asti. Tämän hankinnan tavoitteena on saada Vantaan Energialle käyttöön uudet lämpöenergiamittarit, joiden vaatimukset, etäluennan toimivuus ja mittaustiedon saanti taataan pitkälle 2030 luvun puolelle. Kilpailutuksen kohteena olevien lämpöenergiamittareiden ja järjestelmä- /palveluvaatimukset löytyvät tarjouskyselystä.

title: Radon Measurement Device Evaluation 2026 - 2031
description: Health Canada requires services to ensure that radon measurement devices available in Canada are evaluated for their performance on an annual basis. This is to ensure that any new entrants to the marketplace are evaluated within a reasonable timeframe to ensure they meet minimum performance standards. As a result of this service the vendor will produce a series of publicly available consumer reports on commercially available electronic radon testing devices to ensure the findings of these tests are communicated with consumers. Health Canada will use the information to review testing guidelines, recommendations and protocols. The scope of this work encompasses the development and ongoing administration of a performance evaluation and testing program for radon measurement devices commercially available to Canadian consumers. The work must be designed to assess device performance under conditions that reflect how residents would realistically deploy and use such devices in their homes, ensuring that test results are representative of actual indoor radon activity concentrations.

title: Real Property capital project delivery services
description: Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development (DFATD) advances Canada’s values and interests internationally, delivers international programs and administers Canada’s international aid program to alleviate poverty in the developing world and provide humanitarian assistance. The department provides commercial and consular services to Canadians at home and abroad and manages the Government of Canada’s global network of missions. DFATD is the custodian of a diverse international real estate portfolio and delivers real property services to support Government of Canada program objectives through the provision of safe, secure, productive, environmentally sustainable and affordable workplaces and services that function for its employees and partners, while contributing to the support and promotion of Canada’s posture on the world stage. A new procurement vehicle is required to procure services to support a wide range of potential project delivery methods leveraging private sector expertise and capacity, including for investment analysis, architecture and engineering design, property maintenance and construction to meet ongoing DFATD needs. DFATD requires various categories of professional service experts with experience in the management and administration of real property to support the delivery of capital projects.

description: ADDENDUM 002 -Amendments 002 Important Note: The closing date for the initial RFSA solicitation period is the date posted on page 1 of the RFSA Document. This requirement is for the Department of Fisheries and Oceans (DFO). Title: Request for Supply Arrangement – Ghost Gear The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada has a requirement to establish Supply Arrangements for crews and vessels capable of retrieving and appropriately disposing of ghost gear in Canadian waters when the need arises. DFO’s retrieval requirement might be different every time ghost gear is reported due to the conditions, location, sensitive habitats and gear type. DFO does not know the specific requirements until the location and gear is observed. • Retrieval activities may include: mapping capacity (ie. Side scan sonar or similar) to identify targets • Retrieval (by various methods including but not limited to: by hand from vessel, commercial diver, remotely operated vehicle (ROV), barge and excavator). • Transportation to disposal location which may require a boat, barge, truck, etc. • Disposal, including recycling when appropriate PERIOD OF THE SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT The resulting Supply Arrangement will have no defined end-date and will remain valid until such time as Canada no longer considers it to be advantageous to use it. SECURITY There is no security requirement for this contract. Suppliers working under this Supply Arrangement must not be given access to sensitive information or assets, and must be escorted at all times while on DFO premises. Arrangements not meeting the mandatory criteria will be excluded from further consideration. Mandatory Criteria M1 The Supplier must have experience in one or more of the following: 1. surveying 2. retrieving ghost gear from in water 3. transporting ghost gear 4. responsibly disposing of ghost gear 4. Returning of identifiable gear IMPORTANT NOTICE on Insurance Requirements: At the Request for Proposal (RFP) stage, the Offeror will be required to provide valid certificates of insurance demonstrating that the insurance coverage applicable to the nature of the work is in place and maintained. title: Refrigeration and HVAC Services at the Pacific Biological Station (PBS), Nanaimo, British Columbia (B.C.).
description: BACKGROUND INFORMATION Canada is seeking offers from Offerors to provide refrigeration and HVAC maintenance and repair services to the Pacific Biological Station (PBS) of the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) located in Nanaimo B.C. Canada intends to issue up to two (2) Standing Offers. Compliant offers will be ranked in ascending order according to their total evaluated price. The compliant offer with the lowest evaluated price will be ranked first, and the compliant offer with the second-lowest evaluated price will be ranked second. Canada may issue fewer than two Standing Offers if fewer than two compliant offers are received. SCOPE OF WORK The Contractor must provide all labour, materials, tools, equipment, supervision, and travel necessary to deliver refrigeration and HVAC maintenance and repair services on an as-and-when-requested basis by means of a Call-up against the Standing Offer at the Pacific Biological Station (PBS), Nanaimo, British Columbia, for the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO). All work must be performed in accordance with the applicable federal and provincial codes, regulations, and standards listed under the References section of this standing offer. Where discrepancies exist between codes, the most stringent requirement applies. A. Services Services required under this standing offer include, but are not limited to: a. Assembling pipe sections, tubing, and fittings using couplings, clamps, screws, bolts, cement, plastic solvent, caulking, soldering, brazing, and welding equipment; b. Filling pipes or HVAC fixtures with water or air and observing pressure gauges to detect and locate leaks; c. Servicing glycol heating and cooling loops; d. Servicing and installing boilers (steam and condensing) and associated equipment; e. Servicing rooftop units, heat pumps, and hydronic heating systems; f. Servicing heat exchangers; g. Reviewing blueprints, building codes, and specifications to determine work details and procedures; h. Preparing written cost estimates for labour and materials prior to commencing work (see Section 7 — Scheduling); i. Studying building plans and inspecting structures to assess material and equipment needs, establish pipe installation sequences, and plan installations around obstructions such as electrical wiring; j. Maintaining records of all assignments and producing detailed work reports; k. Performing calculations and planning for complex or large-scale jobs; l. Locating and marking positions of pipe installations, connections, passage holes, and fixtures using precision measuring instruments including rulers and laser levels; m. Measuring, cutting, threading, and bending pipe to required angles using hand and power tools, including pipe cutters, pipe-threading machines, and pipe-bending machines; n. Installing pipe assemblies, fittings, and valves for all HVAC equipment; o. Cutting openings in structures to accommodate pipes and pipe fittings using hand and power tools; p. Hanging steel supports from ceiling joists (concrete, steel, or wood) to hold pipes in place; q. Repairing and maintaining HVAC equipment, including replacing defective components, mending or replacing broken pipes, and clearing clogged drains; r. Directing workers engaged in pipe cutting, preassembly, and installation of plumbing systems and components; and s. Supplying and installing stainless steel, ABS, and PVC piping, valves, and associated fixtures for HVAC equipment. B. Equipment Equipment covered under this standing offer includes, but is not limited to: • Distribution piping systems: PVC, ABS, steel, stainless steel, copper, cast iron, PEX, and flexible steel-braided; • Water and glycol circulation pumps; • Sump pumps; • Valves: ball, gate, butterfly, globe, pinch, disc check, and equivalent types; • Safety valves associated with the ammonia refrigeration system; • Glycol heating loop equipment; • Boilers: steam and condensing; • Rooftop units, heat pumps, and hydronic heating systems; • Air compressors; • Air dryers; and • Heat exchangers. CALL-UP PROCEDURES – RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL 1. Call-up by Authorized Representative. The Identified User’s authorized representative places a Call-up under the Standing Offer for goods, services, or both included in, and at the prices and in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in, the Standing Offer. 2. Multiple Standing Offers. Call-ups will be issued using a right of first refusal basis: The call-up procedures require that when a requirement is identified, the Identified User will contact the highest-ranked offeror to determine if the requirement can be satisfied by that offeror. If the highest-ranked offeror is able to meet the requirement, a call-up is made against its standing offer. If that offeror is unable to meet the requirement, the identified user will contact the next ranked offeror. The identified user will continue and proceed as above until one offeror indicates that it can meet the requirement of the call-up. In other words, call-ups are made based on the “right of first refusal” basis. When the highest-ranked offeror is unable to fulfill the need, the identified user is required to document its file appropriately. The resulting call-ups are considered competitive and the competitive call-up authorities can be used. LOCATION OF WORK Pacific Biological Station, Nanaimo, British Columbia. Services will be provided at a multi-building research campus comprising laboratories, office buildings, aquaculture facilities, refrigeration systems, and associated infrastructure. STANDING OFFER PERIOD The period for issuing Call-ups and providing services against the Standing Offer is from Standing Offer issuance to the date that is five (5) years thereafter (the “Expiry Date”), inclusive. TRAVEL AND LIVING EXPENSES Canada will not pay any travel or living expenses associated with performing the Work. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS There are no security requirements associated with this solicitation of offers or the Standing Offer; however, security requirements may be applicable at the time of issuance of Call-ups. Trade Agreements This procurement is subject to the provisions of the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA), the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), the Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (CUKTCA), and other applicable trade agreements.

title: TSPS - 2. Business Consulting change management services - Evaluation of WAGE's Components - Interviews, Surveys and Case Studies for the Evaluation of WAGE’s Components under the Federal 2SLGBTQI+ Action Plan
description: The objective of this requirement is to obtain professional evaluation services to conduct Key Informant Interviews, a Survey of funded recipients and unfunded applicants, and Case Studies in support of the evaluation of Women and Gender Equality Canada (WAGE)’s components under the Federal 2SLGBTQI+ Action Plan (2022–23 to 2025–26). The purpose of this evaluation is to assess the extent to which WAGE has achieved its intended outcomes, drawing on several years of implementation. This evaluation adopts a summative approach to generate evidence on program relevance, implementation and governance, effectiveness and sustainability, and efficiency. The evaluation plan was presented to WAGE PMEC in June 2026. It will focus on the period from 2022–23 to 2025–26 and includes a combination of lines of evidence to ensure the robustness and credibility of findings. In particular, the lines of evidence covered by this statement of work are the key informant interviews, survey and case studies to support accountability and inform future decision-making by identifying key results, lessons learned, and areas for improvement to strengthen ongoing and future programming.

title: Netherlands – Transport services (excl. Waste transport) – Deelbakfietsen Ede
description: De Gemeente Ede wenst de exploitatie van deelauto's in Ede-Centrum en elektrische deelbakfietsen in de hele Gemeente Ede in de markt te leggen middels concessies. Met deze concessies beoogt de Gemeente een kwalitatief, toekomstbestendig en toegankelijk aanbod van deelauto’s en elektrische deelbakfietsen te realiseren, passend bij de ruimtelijke ontwikkeling van het centrumgebied en de mobiliteitsopgaven van de Gemeente. In verband met de verschillende markten en de verschillende concessiegebieden voor deelauto’s en elektrische bakfietsen kiest de Gemeente ervoor om deze concessies middels twee aanbestedingen uit te vragen: één voor elektrische deelbakfietsen en één voor deelauto's. Deze aanbesteding betreft de aanbesteding elektrische deelbakfietsen. De opdracht betreft de concessie voor de exploitatie van elektrische deelbakfietsen in de Gemeente Ede. De concessie wordt uitgevoerd binnen drie regimes: • Regime 1: basisaanbod deelbakfietsen in Ede-Centrum binnen het werkingsgebied Mobiliteitsfonds (zoals weergegeven in Bijlage 2); • Regime 2: het behouden van aanbod van deelbakfietsen op 14 reeds bewezen locaties. • Regime 3: organische uitbreiding in de rest van Ede;

title: France – Guard services – 26.741.01 SÉCURISATION DES LOCAUX ET GESTION A DISTANCE PAR TELESURVEILLANCE DES SITES DE LA CAISSE PRIMAIRE CENTRALE D’ASSURANCE MALADIE DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE
description: Lot N°1 - SÉCURISATION RECURRENTE DES LOCAUX DE LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE ET SECURISATION PONCTUELLE : Pour le lot n°1, il est attendu : - La sécurisation des agents, des assurés et le contrôle d’accès de neuf sites comprenant le Centre Administratif de Valmante et huit agences par la mise à disposition d’agents de sécurité sur les sites concernés ; - La sécurisation ponctuelle à la demande en cas d’évènements exceptionnels, hors sécurisation à la demande énoncée dans le lot 2, concernant l'ensemble des sites. Il s’agit ici d’assurer la sécurité des agents et des assurés en cas d’évènements exceptionnels pouvant porter atteinte à leur intégrité physique (ex : grèves, manifestations externes et internes, agressions verbales et /ou physiques dans l’une des agences, etc …) Lot N°2 – GESTION DE LA SECURITE DES SITES DE LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE PAR TELESURVEILLANCE, INTERVENTIONS ET GARDIENNAGE D’URGENCE Pour le lot n°2, il est attendu : - La gestion à distance concernant l'ensemble des sites par télésurveillance ; - La gestion des interventions suite à un déclenchement d’alarme ou à la demande de la CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhône ou d’un appel extérieur concernant l'ensemble des sites (levée de doute) ; - Gardiennage d’urgence à la demande concernant l’ensemble des sites (limitée à 4 semaines maximum). Il s’agit ici d’assurer le gardiennage des bâtiments suite à une intervention ayant relevé un risque pour celui-ci (ex : intrusion, dysfonctionnement, faille sécuritaire, etc) Les missions relevant du présent accord-cadre doivent permettre d’assurer la sécurité incendie, de surveiller l’accès aux locaux des sites, de prévenir, intervenir, et contrôler toute action suspecte sur le site, accueillir, renseigner, secourir tout individu en difficulté.

title: France – Health services – MAFA n°26.533.03 PRESTATIONS DE SERVICE DE PREVENTION ET DE SANTE AU TRAVAIL INTERENTREPRISES (SPSTI) POUR LA CPCAM DES BOUCHES-DU-RHONE
description: La CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhone souhaite s'allouer les services d'un SPSTI afin d'assurer la sécurité et la santé (physique et mentale) de ses salariés et d'éviter leur altération du fait du travail. Le marché se déroulera sous la forme d'un accord-cadre à bons de commande et concerne l'ensemble des agents de la CPCAM des Bouches-du-Rhône (2362 agents au 01/08/26) situé sur plusieurs sites présents sur le département.

description: RFI XXXXXXXXX Page 4 of 4 Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) QGenda On-Call Full Range Scheduling Software Request for Information (RFI) Introduction This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation nor does it restrict the government as to the ultimate acquisition approach. In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The purpose of this RFI is to identify qualified vendors, who are able to meet the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) requirements for brand name QGenda On-Call Full Range (FR), a comprehensive clinical scheduling and on-call management solution. See draft Product Description. The Government is not responsible for any cost incurred by industry in furnishing this information. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested vendor's expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future Request for Proposal (RFP), if any is issued. Any information submitted by respondents to this RFI is strictly voluntary. All submissions will become Government property and will not be returned. Interested vendors are responsible for adequately marking proprietary, restricted or competition sensitive information contained in their response. RFI Response Instructions NOTE: The capability package must be clear, concise, and complete. VA is under no obligation to provide feedback to the company, or to contact the company for clarification of any information submitted in response to this RFI. Provide the following information: Provide Company Information: Company Name CAGE/DUNS Number under which the company is registered in SAM/VetBiz.gov Company Address Point of contact name Telephone number Email address For small business concerns, indicate whether at least 50 percent of the total amount paid by the Government will be paid to firms that are similarly situated. Brief summary describing your company s technical approach to meeting the requirements, to include: List any previous or existing contracts you have with the VA where similar work was performed to this requirement. Also, is there an existing contract vehicle you recommend be used for this procurement? Does the draft Product Description (PD) provide sufficient detail to describe the technical and functional requirements that encompass the requirement? If NO , please provide your technical and functional comments/recommendations/questions on elements of the draft outline that may contribute to a more accurate proposal submission and efficient, cost-effective effort. If your company is a Small Business, also include the following: The intent and ability to meet set-aside requirements for performance of this effort. Information as to proposed team members, the percentage of work each is to perform, and which PD requirements would be subcontracted. Responses are due at 10:00 AM EST, October 13th. Submit your responses directly to Ana Subashi ana.subashi@va.gov. Should you have any questions, please reach out to: Contract Specialist: Ana Subashi. ana.subashi@va.gov AND Contracting Officer: Kendra Casebolt. kendra.casebolt@va.gov All responsible sources may submit a response in accordance with the following: All proprietary/company confidential material shall be clearly marked on every page that contains such. Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB) and Veteran Owned Small Businesses (VOSB) must indicate whether at least 50% of the cost incurred would be expended for prime employees or employees of other eligible SDVOSB/VOSB firms. This should also include the prime planned percentage and if under 50%, the names of the potential team members that may be used to fulfill the 50% SDVOSB/VOSB requirement. Please keep your response to no more than 6 pages. **See attached document: DRAFT - Product Description - QGenda On-Call FR.**

title: Travel Management Office (TMO) Travel Program (Defense Travel System (DTS) & Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC)) and Mail Management Center (MMC) Technical and Administrative Support Services.
description: This is a SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE (SSN) announcement. SSNs are issued to assist the Agency in performing market research to determine industry interest and capability. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this synopsis. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. Therefore, no proposals are being requested or accepted in response to this SSN. In accordance with (IAW) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, SSP is conducting market research to determine if sources are capable of successfully performing the requirements identified in this SSN. Specifically, SSP is seeking capable firms to provide Travel Management Office (TMO) Travel Program support for the Defense Travel System (DTS) and Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC), as well as Mail Management Center (MMC) technical and administrative support services for Strategic Systems Programs. The requirement is currently anticipating a Firm-Fixed-Price, Level-of-Effort (FFP-LOE), Term Contract CLIN support for a five-year ordering period from 10 May 2027 through 9 May 2032. Support includes travel program management, help desk support, travel auditing and analysis, GTCC administrative support, and official mail handling operations.

title: Y1DA--STATION - BK SPS Dead Leg Removal
description: Special Notice Special Notice Page 4 of 4 Special Notice *= Required Field Special Notice Page 1 of 4 The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office (NCO 2) intends to award a sole source contract to American Standard Group LLC., 88 Farrington Rd. Matawan NJ 07747 the authority of 41 U.S.C 253-c-1, as implemented in FAR 6.302-1 Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. Given the urgency, precision required, the contamination risks associated with improper handling, and the need for continuity in both technique and safety standards, onboarding a new contractor introduces unacceptable risk of system compromise, extended downtime, and potential disruption to SPS operations. For these reasons, no other contractors can feasibly perform the work without significant safety, quality, and operational risks, and the previously engaged contractor is the only source capable of meeting the technical, safety, and emergency requirements of this RO deadleg removal action. Period of Performance: The period of performance is 60 calendar days from notice to proceed. This notice of intent is not a request for quotations; interested parties may express their interest by providing a capabilities statement no later than Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, at 10:00am EST. The capabilities statement must provide clear and unambiguous evidence to substantiate the capability of the party to provide the required services. A determination not to compete this proposed requirement upon receipt of responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Verbal responses are not acceptable and will not be considered. After October 13th, 2026, at 10:00am EST, if no viable responses have been received in response to this announcement, the Department of Veterans Affairs shall negotiate solely with American Standard Group LLC. The Government believes the services outlined in the Scope of Work cannot be provided by another firm. It is necessary that American Standard Group LLC. completes this project to prevent further delays to patients in need of healthcare. This notice of intent to award a sole source contract is not a request for competitive quotes. There will be no solicitation available for competitive quotes. Phone calls will not be accepted. The point of contact for this action is Charlie Augustin, Contracting Officer Charlie.Augustin@va.gov The Government anticipates awarding a firm-fixed- price contract. A determination to compete this proposed requirement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competition.

title: Fitness Center O&M Sources Sought
description: PLEASE SUBMIT ALL RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT TO JAMIE MELZER-COMPTON AT JLMELZER@FBI.GOV BY TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026, AT 10:00 AM ET. Introduction This notice is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for proposal or quote. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the government. Responses in any form are not offers and the government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary. Background The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Sources Sought synopsis as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support this requirement for establishing, managing, and operating Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services. The Government expects the Contractor to operate the Fitness Center at FBI Redstone to include on-site fitness center coordination, program coordinator, certified personal trainer, equipment maintenance and repair staff, fitness center management staff and ensure a complete, effective, well-balanced, exercise and equipment maintenance program. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 713940. The total period of performance for this contract, to include all options, shall not exceed five (5) calendar years. Contractor Qualifications If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: Firm Information: Organization name (Legal/DBA), Address, Point of Contact (POC), E-mail address, Website address, Telephone number, UEI Number Cage Code, Facility Clearance (if applicable), GSA Schedule (if applicable), and Size and type of ownership for the organization A brief description of at least two (2), but no more than three (3), Fitness Center O&M services similar to the requirements described within the Background Section above. The prior services provided shall be within the past five (5) years. Minimum information should include the following: contract number, total contract value, project location, period of performance, and a brief description of the services. Provide a general statement of your qualifications, capabilities, and ability to perform the required types of work described. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. Information and suggestions that may encourage new, different, or innovative approaches that would result in products, solutions, and direct savings to the FBI. Contemplated Requirement The FBI is issuing this Sources Sought to: Gather industry information on Fitness Center Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services at FBI Redstone. Request information on any industry changes or improvements that the FBI should consider when looking to achieve products and capabilities that meet requirements and are compatible with the commercial environment. Request information on potential barriers to obtaining solutions that meet objectives needed to accomplish stated requirements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: Provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated. Secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements. Implement a successful project management plan that includes compliance with program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of key personnel and risk mitigation. Provide services under a performance-based service acquisition contract. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice/market research, this requirement may be set-aside for small businesses or procured through full and open competition, and multiple awards may be made. title: Enterprise Grocery Product Content Creation, Management, and Syndication Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Solution
description: This Call for Solutions is issued under the Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002. Army Contracting Command � Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) in support of the Defense Commissary Agency is seeking for solutions for Enterprise Grocery Product Content Creation, Management, and Syndication SaaS Solution The Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) is a component of the Department of War (DoW) that provides enterprise-wide mission support to all United States (U.S.) uniformed services, including the Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, and Coast Guard, in both continental United States (CONUS) and outside of the continental United States (OCONUS) locations. DeCA�s mission is to deliver a vital benefit of the military compensation package that improves quality of life and readiness by providing grocery items at significant savings to military personnel and their families. DeCA operates a global system of 235 commissaries across 45 states, 13 countries, and two U.S. territories, with approximately 3,000 checkout lanes. To support modern, multi-channel retail operations, DeCA requires a robust, centralized enterprise capability to acquire, create, validate, manage, and syndicate product images, digital assets, specifications, dimensions, metadata, and related content. This system is essential for driving digital commerce, in-store merchandising, automated planogramming, marketing, and global store operations. DeCA manages a highly diverse, worldwide grocery portfolio. Accurate, consistent, and timely product content is critical across multiple downstream business functions, including eCommerce platforms, digital marketing, category management, shelf planning, and physical store operations. DeCA is seeking an integrated Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution combining centralized Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Product Information Management (PIM) capabilities with content creation services, supplier collaboration tools, and automated system integration. The Call for Solutions document, submission requirements can be found in the Attachments section below. The deadline to submit questions for Phase I is 01 October 2026 at 12:00 PM EDT

title: Project Management Technical Admin Support Services
description: This is not a solicitation for proposals or quotations. The Department of State, Bureau of Arms Control and Nonproliferation, Office of the Nonproliferation and Disarmament Fund (ACN/NDF), is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing professional technical administrative support services for ACN/NDF's Project Management support activities. The objective of the anticipated requirement is to optimize daily operations, streamline workflow management, and ensure the seamless execution of project milestones through dedicated technical administrative assistance. ACN/NDF is seeking information on contractors capable of providing full-service technical administrative support services tailored to Department of State, NDF�s core functional areas in support of project management, financial management, travel, acquisition and Grants management programs. Anticipated Scope of Work: The anticipated scope includes, but is not limited to, the following core functional areas: Travel Coordination & Expense Processing Support � domestic/international travel arrangements, expense report processing and reconciliation. Document & Information Management Support � drafting, proofreading, and formatting correspondence, memorandums, technical reports, and briefing materials; electronic filing and version control; inquiry routing. Data Entry & Program Tracking Support � maintaining program databases, tracking spreadsheets, and performance metrics; compiling data for periodic reports. Pre-Award Grants & Financial Assistance Support � preparing Notice of Funding Opportunities (NOFOs), coordinating grant intake, and supporting independent merit review panels. Post-Award Grants Administration Support � monitoring grantee compliance, processing progress reports, tracking Federal Financial Reports (FFRs), and compiling award closeout documentation. Anticipated Personnel Qualifications: Respondents should be prepared to demonstrate that personnel possess (or can be readily hired/trained with) working familiarity with or similar to: Department of State financial management systems (e.g., GFMS or successor platforms); Department of State travel management systems (e.g., E2 Solutions or successor platform); Federal grants management platforms (e.g., GrantSolutions, or equivalent pre-/post-award systems); Project Information Management System (PIMS) or equivalent post/program-level information management systems; and Advanced Microsoft Office Suite proficiency (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Security Requirements: All personnel performing under the anticipated contract must possess and maintain a minimum of SECRET-level security clearance at time of award and throughout the period of performance. INSTRUCTION TO RESPONDENTS: Interested and capable sources are requested to submit a capability statement not to exceed [5] pages (excluding cover page and resumes), addressing the following: a. Company Information Company name, address, point of contact, phone/email, and UEI number. Business size and socioeconomic status (e.g., small business, 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone) under the applicable NAICS code. Applicable contract vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS Schedule, GWAC) through which this requirement could be acquired, if any. b. Relevant Corporate Experience Description of up to three (3) recent (within the last 5 years) contracts or task orders of similar size, scope, and complexity, including contract number, dollar value, period of performance, customer POC, and a brief description of services performed. c. Technical Capability Statement Respondents should specifically address their capability and approach in each of the following areas: 1. Systems Proficiency: Demonstrated personnel experience/familiarity with Department of State financial management systems, travel management systems, federal grants management platforms, PIMS or equivalent program tracking systems, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite applications. 2. Personnel Qualifications & Staffing Approach: Approach to recruiting, retaining, and training personnel to meet the qualifications described above, including sample resumes or labor category descriptions for proposed key personnel. 3. Security Clearance Capability: Demonstrated ability to provide personnel who currently possess, or can promptly obtain and maintain, an active SECRET-level clearance for the duration of performance. 4. Grants Administration Experience: Specific experience supporting pre-award and/or post-award federal grants administration functions, including NOFO preparation, merit review panel coordination, and grantee compliance monitoring. d. Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) Pricing (Optional) Respondents may optionally provide a ROM price range for performing the anticipated scope of work, based on the labor and travel assumptions described above, for market research purposes only. This is not a request for proposal and will not be used for award purposes. This RFI/Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research and information-gathering purposes under FAR Part 10. It does not constitute a solicitation, and the Government will not pay for information submitted in response. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future request for proposal (RFP) or request for quotation (RFQ), if any is issued. Any information submitted by respondents to this RFI is strictly voluntary.
